subject: Mathematics

show.line: Morning, afternoon and night. The sun comes up in the morning. The moon comes out at night!

rounds.prompt: When do we wake up and brush our teeth? Tap the picture.
rounds.praise: Yes! We wake up in the morning.

rounds.prompt: When do we see the moon and stars?
rounds.praise: Yes! The moon comes out at night.

rounds.prompt: Look. The child is sleeping. Is it morning or night?

rounds.story: In the morning Zanele eats pap. In the afternoon she plays soccer. What does she do in the afternoon?
rounds.praise: Yes! She plays soccer in the afternoon.

rounds.prompt: Day or night? Put each picture in its group.
Morning, afternoon, then what comes next?

hints: In the morning the sun comes up. At night it is dark.
Think about what you do. Sleep is at night.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will say when we sleep.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: We sleep in the morning, when the sun comes up!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! We sleep at night, when it is dark.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's think together. It is dark and the moon is out. That is night!

parent_line: Can tell morning, afternoon and night apart.
